Method (Phase 3 freeze report, sections 3 and 12; submission configuration V5P4): uniform slot grid with invalid slots for
dropped, zero, NaN and stuck rows; the trailing invalid run is the blind window; integrated-random-walk gravity smoother with a
gap-length-squared rotation-uncertainty law on 12.5 Hz block means; thrust-lock platform gate; gyro bias as a 20 s-knot spline
(rotor) or constant / rest-anchored (hand-held, unless a drift test fires); position as a Kalman smoother of a stationary motion
prior measured by the world-frame specific force (rotor: 17-state spring-damper + rotor drag + lever arm at 25 Hz; hand-held:
Matern-5/2 at 100 Hz), zero-velocity rows at genuine rest, gap-scaled accelerometer-bias variance; radius guard; blind window:
rotor = damped velocity (0.5 s), hand-held = the smoother's own prediction, orientation held.

Method (Phase 3 freeze report, sections 3 and 12; submission configuration V5P4, with the Phase 5 changes of v1.1.0): uniform
slot grid with invalid slots for dropped, zero, NaN and stuck rows; the trailing invalid run is the blind window; integrated-
random-walk gravity smoother with a gap-length-squared rotation-uncertainty law on 12.5 Hz block means (time constant 3 s on the
rotor path, 24 s on the hand-held path, where motion acceleration would otherwise leak into the tilt); thrust-lock platform gate;
gyro bias as a 20 s-knot spline (rotor) or constant / rest-anchored (hand-held, unless a drift test fires); position as a Kalman
smoother of a stationary motion prior measured by the world-frame specific force (rotor: 17-state spring-damper + rotor drag +
lever arm at 25 Hz; hand-held: Matern-5/2 at 100 Hz), zero-velocity rows at genuine rest (quiet 0.5 s windows: gyro sd below
0.06 rad/s, which also covers a drone standing on the ground with its rotors spinning), no drag rows at rest (they would measure
the ground reaction), gap-scaled accelerometer-bias variance; when the rotor solution spans a large workspace (radius >= 1.7 m)
it is smoothed again with a steady drag-row offset; radius guard; blind window: rotor = damped velocity (0.5 s), hand-held = the
smoother's own prediction, orientation held.
